summary: Quantization tutorial: subagent did multiple rounds before continuation hung. Main-session DIY did 1 substantive round (WARN on length + style nit). Final 13/13 render PASS. 1343 lines content-dense. UPDATE 2026-07-12 (round 5, P0 resweep): Codex GPT-5.6-sol candidate pass + independent Claude Sonnet 5 adversarial verification (tried to refute every finding — none REFUTED) surfaced 15 CONFIRMED + 1 NEEDS_NUANCE precision/correctness issues, all fixed in both ZH/EN: (1) rounding tie-point discrepancy corrected from '0.5 ULP' to 'a full quantization step s (1 LSB)'; (2) GPTQ complexity formula fixed to O(MK²+K³+NK²), and the §4.5 pseudocode's docstring now clarifies it's a direct (non-batched, mathematically correct) update rather than the real lazy block-batched implementation, plus a block_size-vs-group_size distinction; (3) AWQ's salient-channel protection mechanism corrected (not 'finer per-channel scale' — protection comes from the inverse-transform error reduction, ~1/s_c); (4) an `s.mean()` docstring fixed from 'geometric mean' to 'arithmetic mean' (code unchanged); (5) the LayerNorm-fusion equivalence for AWQ/SmoothQuant scale-merging now notes the bias term (`prev_ln_bias`) must also be divided by s for bias-bearing LayerNorm (OPT/BLOOM) — `apply_smoothing()` gained an optional `prev_ln_bias` parameter; (6) SmoothQuant's 'skip out_proj/down_proj smoothing' clarified to NOT mean 'keep FP16' — those layers still get INT8 quantized; (7) QuIP's W'=UWV^T equivalence completed to the full Wx=U^T W'(Vx) relation; (8) QuaRot's RMSNorm-γ/Hadamard commutativity fix corrected (γ is fused offline into the next layer's weights, not resolved by online Hadamard); (9) **a genuine E4M3FN encoder round-trip bug**: `fp8_e4m3_encode`'s overflow check `if biased_e >= 15` incorrectly saturated ALL legal values in [256,448) to 448 — fixed to `if biased_e > 15`, manually verified (ax=300 now correctly encodes to 288.0 instead of being wrongly saturated to 448.0; 11 sample points across [256,448) now decode to 6 distinct legal values instead of all collapsing to one); (10) E8M0's legal exponent range corrected from [0,255] to [0,254] (255=0xFF reserved for NaN); (11) Q11's H=X^TX 'input Hessian vs weight Hessian' false dichotomy resolved (they're the same object); (12) the Hadamard incoherence bound now notes it requires randomized-sign Hadamard and holds with high probability, plus a missing √(log d) factor; (13) QServe's unsourced '1000+ tokens/s/H100' claim removed (paper's actual hardware is A100/L40S); (14) Q22's dequant+MMA 'fused in one warp instruction' corrected to software-pipelined overlap (mma.sync has no built-in dequant logic); (15) §2.3's bits/weight formula (4+16/g) now correctly labeled as symmetric-quantization-only (no zero-point), with the asymmetric formula 4+(16+4)/g added; (16) OCP MX spec year corrected 2024→2023 (v1.0 published 2023). No standalone .py script exists for this tutorial (all code lives inline in markdown code blocks).
